title: PCBI_V1_3_1_GAP_STATUS_MODEL
description: Formal governance model separating PCBI catalog existence from historical data availability.

dimension_1_definition_status.name: PCBI_DEFINITION_STATUS
dimension_1_definition_status.description: Evaluates whether a formal PCBI technical specification and commodity definition exists in the catalog.

values.label: Defined in PCBI Master Catalog
values.description: Benchmark record exists with technical ID, scope, formula, and governance parameters.

values.label: Missing from PCBI Master Catalog
values.description: No benchmark profile exists for this commodity; admin action required to create definition.

values.label: Under Review
values.description: Proposed benchmark definition undergoing governance review or committee evaluation.

values.label: Not Benchmarkable
values.description: Classified as non-benchmarkable spend (e.g. customized industrial services, facilities, unindexed items).

dimension_2_data_status.name: PCBI_DATA_STATUS
dimension_2_data_status.description: Evaluates the historical depth, continuity, frequency, and source verification of time-series observations.

values.label: Complete History
values.description: Continuous historical observations available covering 100% of required client spend evaluation period (2020-2026).

values.label: Partial History
values.description: Observations exist for recent periods but historical series has gaps or starts later than required.

values.label: No Historical Observations
values.description: PCBI definition may exist, but zero time-series price or index observations have been ingested.

values.label: Frequency Mismatch
values.description: Source frequency differs from requirement (e.g. monthly benchmark published for weekly client procurement requirement).

values.label: Specification Mismatch
values.description: Index observations track a different grade, form-factor, or purity requiring documented transformation.

values.label: Source Unverified
values.description: Historical data points exist from an unvalidated candidate source without verified provenance.

orthogonalityPrinciple.statement: PCBI_DEFINITION_STATUS being DEFINED must NOT imply that PCBI_DATA_STATUS is COMPLETE.
orthogonalityPrinciple.dashboardRequirement: The dashboard and reporting layers must show both dimensions separately.
